hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git commit|git push"; then BRANCH=$(git -C "$(pwd)" symbolic-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed "s|refs/heads/||"); if [ "$BRANCH" = "baseline/v1.3.0" ]; then echo "ERROR: 禁止在 baseline/v1.3.0 上直接执行 git commit / git push。请先创建 feature 分支：git checkout -b feat/your-feature" >&2; exit 1; fi; fi'
